title: Search response
description: Ranked results for one search request (issue #180). Each result is a reference only (`kind` + `id`, plus `parent_id` when the owning endpoint needs it) into the resource it came from, e.g. {kind: 'textbook_block', id: 'blk_...', parent_id: 'doc_...'}; the caller re-fetches full content through that resource's own endpoint. `score`: higher is more relevant; keyword mode is tsvector-rank scale, semantic mode is cosine similarity, hybrid mode is the fused RRF score -- scores are not comparable across modes. `source` says which leg(s) produced this hit; 'hybrid' means both the keyword and semantic legs matched. A drill item's expected-answer or reference-solution content, and any holdout drill (sys:holdout), is never a legal source of a result -- only a non-holdout drill's question/prompt text is ever indexed (contracts/schemas/search/README.md). Results are scoped to the authenticated learner: only shared corpus rows and rows that learner owns (e.g. their memos) are ever returned.

parent_id.description: Id of the owning resource when re-fetching this result needs it, e.g. the document id of a 'textbook_block' or the workspace id of a 'memo_entry'. Absent for a top-level resource.
